TITLE: Enhanced Due Diligence for Crypto Merchants
CONTENT: Document ID: RI360-UP-001. Purpose: This synthetic policy mandates enhanced due diligence for all transactions involving cryptocurrency merchants. Control requirements: 1. Flag transactions above 5000 at crypto merchants for manual review. 2. Require source-of-funds documentation for crypto transactions above 15000. 3. Apply 30-day lookback for velocity checks on crypto merchant activity.

TITLE: Cross-Border Wire Transfer Monitoring
CONTENT: Document ID: RI360-UP-002. Purpose: This synthetic policy establishes monitoring controls for cross-border wire transfers. Control requirements: 1. Screen all cross-border wires against sanctions lists. 2. Flag wire transfers above 10000 that cross more than two jurisdictions within 24 hours. 3. Escalate structuring patterns where multiple wires just below reporting thresholds originate from the same customer.

TITLE: Rapid Velocity Alert Thresholds
CONTENT: Document ID: RI360-UP-003. Purpose: This synthetic document defines velocity-based alert thresholds for transaction monitoring. Control requirements: 1. Trigger alert when a customer exceeds 5 transactions within any 60-minute window. 2. Escalate to investigation when daily transaction count exceeds 10 for any single customer. 3. Apply enhanced monitoring for customers with velocity alerts across multiple channels.
